title: Replacement Free Night Awards After a Relocation Past the Expiry Date
content:
## The rule

When an award comes back from a reservation the hotel relocated after the award's expiry date had passed, a replacement is deposited. A replacement is of the same type as the award it replaces, carries the reason that it replaces an earlier award and that award's reference, and its expiry date is worked out as the Free Night Awards terms set out.

## When the expiry date is set

A replacement's expiry date is set only after the award it replaces stands back in the member's account with its return from the relocated stay entered in its history.

Restated: while the award to be replaced does not stand back in the member's account with its return from the relocated stay entered in its history, no expiry date is set for its replacement.

## Situation of use and capability

`reissue_replacement_award_0d99e6ce` deposits a new Free Night Award into a member's Ashbury Rewards account to replace an earlier award. It issues one award: a new award is created in the membership given, of the type given, with status issued, the current date as its issue date, the expiry date given, no top-off points, the reason given and a link to the award it replaces; it receives a new award number. Afterwards the new award appears in the member's account as usable.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `reissue_replacement_award_0d99e6ce`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `replaced_certificate_id` | The reference number of the earlier award this new award replaces, read from the member's award records | Identifier |
| `loyalty_member_id` | The reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership the new award is deposited into, read from the member's membership records | Identifier |
| `issue_source` | Why the new award is issued | One value of the enumeration below |
| `variant_name` | The award type of the new award, written as the official award name | One value of the enumeration below |
| `expiry_date` | The last date on which a stay night covered by the new award may fall | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time |

Values of `issue_source`:

- `cobrand_anniversary`: deposited for a co-brand card account anniversary;
- `elite_milestone`: deposited because the year's elite night credits reached a milestone;
- `promotion`: deposited for a completed registered promotion;
- `reissue_replacement`: replaces an earlier award.

Values of `variant_name`: `25K Free Night Award` (a night priced up to 25000 points), `35K Free Night Award` (up to 35000 points), `40K Free Night Award` (up to 40000 points), `50K Free Night Award` (up to 50000 points), `85K Free Night Award` (up to 85000 points), `Any Hotel Free Night Award` (uncapped, usable at any eligible hotel).

## Return

On success: a text rendering of a dictionary with `certificate_id` (the reference number of the new award), `certificate_number` (the new award number, FNA followed by 8 digits), `variant_name` (the award type), `issued_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `expiry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (always `issued` on success). Receiving this dictionary means the new award is in the member's account.
